name: novel-research
description: Define bounded, source-aware research questions and record their story impact.
procedure: Identify only factual uncertainties that can materially alter story choices.
Declare required evidence, acceptable confidence, affected project docs, and a bounded answer format.
Persist questions and sourced findings as data; never promote unverified material to canon.
Choose the next step from the author's goal and current project state; keep progress in project docs and verify persisted tool results.
